title: H10 medium-horizon Donchian trend screen
purpose: Evaluate a materially different, lower-turnover replacement candidate after H8 and H9 failed; historical results alone cannot authorize live trading.

data.type: 5m contract klines aggregated to UTC-aligned 4h bars
data.quality_policy: Reuse only HY-EXP-0015 files whose hashes pass its locked manifest; reject duplicate, non-contiguous, incomplete or misaligned bars.

strategy.entry: When a completed 4h close is strictly above the prior 120-bar high, buy at the next 4h open; when strictly below the prior 120-bar low, sell at the next 4h open.
strategy.exit: Exit at the next 4h open after a completed close crosses the opposite prior 60-bar channel, or at the fixed initial two-ATR intrabar stop, whichever occurs first.
strategy.conflict_policy: While flat, if both long and short entry conditions are somehow true, do not trade. While open, no reversal occurs until the exit is complete. Intrabar stop takes precedence over a later close-based channel exit.
strategy.position_policy: At most one position per symbol; no pyramiding; fixed one-sixth research-account allocation per symbol; no compounding.
strategy.funding: Omitted because the public kline screen does not contain a causal funding ledger; this limitation must be reported.

decision.pass: Eligible only for frozen forward paper validation; not approved to replace H8 in live trading.
decision.fail: Eliminate this exact H10 specification and register a materially different H11 before further testing.
decision.change_policy: Any feature, threshold, channel, stop, cost, universe or date change requires a new experiment id.
